evidence.excerpt: He has an active doctoral student finishing in late 2026, so capacity for new project coordination is limited until 2027; work package participation or contract research roles are more feasible in the near term. He has expressed a preference for collaborations that include data sharing agreements, as access to labelled fault telemetry from new asset types remains the main bottleneck for his group's research.
